chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 550: Realm War's Pause and a Shocking Spy Reveal!
chapter_meta_description: The Realm War pauses as Ji Ning battles the nine-headed lion to a standstill. But a greater threat lurks: The Evergreen Sword Immortal is revealed as the Godking's spy!
og_title: The Spy's Mask Falls: Desolate Era Chapter 550
og_description: Ji Ning proves his mettle against a top demon-god, but the Seamless Gate's ultimate weapon is a trusted friend. Who will fall first?
twitter_title: Ji Ning vs the Nine-Headed Lion! And the spy is... the Evergreen Sword Immortal!?
twitter_description: The Realm War pauses, and a trusted commander is revealed as the Godking's agent. The betrayal is coming.

lore_anchors.definition: A massive Realm War formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals as a foundation and 1,000 Celestial Immortals as a framework. It manifests a powerful, headless divine spirit of god-tier durability.
A veteran commander in the Crimsonbright Territories' armies, revealed in this chapter to be a deeply embedded spy for the Seamless Gate, planted by the Godking himself.
The supreme ruler of the Seamless Gate. He commands the endless hordes of the Seamless Gate and is one of the most powerful and cunning beings in the Three Realms.
The tribulation faced by Fiendgod Body Refiners to become Empyrean Gods. It is considered far more dangerous and prestigious than the Heavenly Tribulation faced by Ki Refiners.
A supreme Daofather who controls the Crimsonbright Territories. He is the supreme commander of the Nuwa camp's forces in this Realm War.
A fearsome combat formation formed by the three great demon-gods of Tunlong Mountain, with the nine-headed lion as its core.
